arm_definition.tail_20pct: frozen CtpExecutor via RecoveredActionRegistry (positive-relation 20% MMES tail reserve is the frozen baseline)
arm_definition.no_reserved_tail: candidate-namespace CTP copy identical to the frozen executor except the positive-relation tail reserve is removed (reserve fraction 0); coverage, relation-cover polish and the exact terminal budget are unchanged

checkpoint_rule: each case/seed generates one fresh Phase-I checkpoint with the frozen run_phase1 (arac-identity-blind-evidence-v9, 180,000 FE) before any arm runs; both arms of a pair share the checkpoint and the action seed
gate_rule: both cases must satisfy R(tail_20pct/no_reserved_tail) < 1 with 95% paired bootstrap CI upper < 1, plus FE/checkpoint/hash/terminal/positive-relation contract compliance
failure_policy: on failure the frozen 20% tail stays unchanged and any tail-ratio tuning branch is permanently closed; line B may continue (different mechanism)
